fusions.name: Dropped Anvil
fusions.desc: Heaves an anvil that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every other enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Forge Tap
fusions.desc: Taps an enemy with a forge-hot smith's stroke, dealing 5 damage, setting it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Work-Hardened
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your blunt resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Blow Upon Blow
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
